rationale: Post-contingency state with l13 out has l12 overloaded at 100 MW (133% of 75 MW rating). DC power flow analysis shows closing tie l14 (x=0.3 pu) redistributes flow: l12 drops to 70.63 MW, all branches within ratings. Opening any single branch (l23/l24/l34) fails to relieve overload. Network remains connected with l14 closed.
